records.source: NASA ICES-2025-345, Status of the Advanced Oxygen Generation Assembly
records.statement: AOGA to be launched to ISS in 2026; design reviews and development tests complete and flight hardware components being manufactured.
Mod-kit delivery planned early calendar year 2026; launch to ISS in the fall.
records.notes: The page update predates the 2026 conference papers; mod-kit delivery and launch are distinct milestones.

records.source: Oliver-Butler et al., ICES-2026-423, Status of the Advanced Oxygen Generation Assembly in 2026
records.statement: AOGA hardware is described as undergoing build and slated to launch to ISS in late 2026.
records.notes: Full PDF was not accessible through the current browser retrieval path; statement taken from the indexed article abstract/metadata.

records.source: Brown et al., ICES-2026-379, ISS as a Testbed for Exploration ECLSS: 2026 Status
records.statement: The report describes delivery planned for mid-2027 and identifies three new manifolds and pressure-sensor qualification among critical-path items.
records.notes: Do not silently equate delivery to integration/testing with launch/activation.

records.statement: NASA lists delivery of the Advanced Oxygen Generation Assembly for testing on ISS as a FY 2027 critical milestone.
records.notes: Agency milestone; delivery for testing is not stated as launch or operational activation.

interpretation.explanation: Forecasts differ and milestone verbs/boundaries are not equivalent. Do not infer a slip cause, choose the most optimistic date, or state actual launch/activation from planned dates alone.
interpretation.required_follow_up: Reconcile revision/configuration, mod-kit delivery, shipment, ISS arrival, integration, launch/installation, activation and critical-system qualification as separate events; update only with a dated primary source or operational record.
